decisions.reason: The offshore and renewables unit sits close to the core ship management business, and industry turnover is growing while the firm expands, so results likely meet aspirations and slack lets it carry a strategically aligned unit even with uncertain early results.

Crew and corporate travel management draws on the firm's large crewing base and supports its own operations, so shortfalls are unlikely to prompt problemistic search, although post-pandemic travel volumes leave some uncertainty.

The online vessel information portal supports customer proximity and digital transparency at low running cost, but digital tools are often consolidated or rebranded, which raises the chance of replacement.

The mobile performance app fits the firm's direction toward cleaner shipping, but standalone apps are frequently folded into broader platforms, so its drop risk is moderate even though slack from an expanding firm favours keeping it.
